Terms & Conditions

By creating a NEXUS account you agree to the following:

1. Encryption — All messages sent on NEXUS are stored with security in mind. Do not share sensitive personal information.

2. Conduct — You will not use NEXUS to harass, threaten, or harm others. Abusive accounts may be removed.

3. Age — You must be 13 or older to use NEXUS.

4. Content — You are responsible for content you send. Do not share illegal, harmful, or offensive material.

5. Privacy — Your username is public to other users. Do not use your real name if you prefer anonymity.

6. Service — NEXUS is provided as-is. We may update or discontinue features at any time.

By clicking CREATE ACCOUNT you confirm you have read and agree to these terms.

TEAM MEMBER DUTIES & RULES
🧪
Test Features
Actively test new and existing features. Leave detailed reviews on what works, what breaks, and what could be better.
🎫
Answer Help Tickets
Monitor incoming help requests from users. Respond helpfully, and escalate anything you can't resolve so the owner can handle it.
💡
Suggest Improvements
Use the Suggestions tab to post ideas for new features, design improvements, or performance fixes. Quality feedback is always valued.
🔒
Keep It Confidential
Unreleased features and internal discussions seen in this portal are confidential. Do not share them outside the team.
✅
Stay Active
Check in regularly. An inactive team member may have their role reviewed. If you need a break, let the owner know.
